recipes.name: LLM-LEx
setup: Install the pinned llmlex package and declared dependencies; prepare the supplied data JSON.

profiles.description: Native llmlex.run_genetic proposes and fits expressions; returned populations retain native negative normalized chi-squared scores.

evaluation.description: Native llmlex.run_genetic proposes and fits expressions; returned populations retain native negative normalized chi-squared scores.

argument_help: Add inputs/data.json through request.inputs; it contains numeric arrays x and y.
Explicit OPENAI_API_KEY and optional OPENAI_BASE_URL; default endpoint is the upstream example OpenRouter API.
limitations: The library has no native search CLI; this driver calls its public genetic loop without changing selection or fitting.
The data are fitted by the native loop. This profile does not add held-out evaluation.
No root license file was found at the pinned revision.
